name: Pho
summary: Pho is a beef or chicken noodle soup in a clear broth. Northern bowls are plainer. Southern bowls come with a sweeter broth and a pile of herbs and lime. Vietnam Tourism says the bowl is best in Hanoi.
origin: The soup is associated with Hanoi, where pho bo is the breakfast standard. The south adapted it with more sugar and more garnish. Vietnam Tourism says phở is best there.
taste: The Hanoi broth on the city’s longer food page is beef bone simmered with star anise, cinnamon, ginger, and black cardamom, then noodles, green onion, and beef or chicken.
howToEat: Eat it at breakfast or lunch. Taste the broth before you add anything.
In Hanoi, start with a bit of chili. Garlic vinegar is for the beef bowl. Lime is for the chicken bowl.
In the south, herbs, bean sprouts, and lime arrive on a plate. Add them as you go.
A busy morning shop with a short menu is the right room.

The delicious-dishes page splits Ho Chi Minh City in two. Northern-style restaurants have a light, clear, less sweet broth and treat fresh beef as the point. Southern-style phở is sweeter. The broth is darker from grilled purple onions and spices, and the bowl comes with bean sprouts, raw vegetables, sliced onions, garlic, and soy sauce.
where: In Hanoi, the morning bowl is in the Hoan Kiem lanes, including Hang Vai.

In Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam Tourism says phở is best in Hanoi and points the reader at hủ tiếu. Visit HCMC still names phở bò on Bùi Viện, and lists phở among iconic dishes. The photograph is a bowl in Hanoi.
The delicious-dishes page does not name a southern street. Bùi Viện is still the street Visit HCMC prints for phở bò.
In Ha Giang, phở is breakfast in town before the ride toward Đồng Văn.

In Hoi An, the Hoi An World Heritage conservation centre’s 7 June 2023 list describes a bowl with herbs, peanuts, beef, and soft rice noodles. A condiment method was not printed. A street and the hour are Check on arrival.

In Ha Long, Báo Quảng Ninh on 13 Mar 2019 calls phở a common breakfast in the city center and at Bãi Cháy, and names a shop on Trần Hưng Đạo. A garnish was not printed. That article printed about 50,000 đồng a bowl. A current price is Check on arrival.
priceBand: A basic bowl is often a cheap street or shop meal. Confirm the board price.
